title: Taste Test: Apothecary Diaries True or False
description: Ten statements on the author, the web novel, the manga, the setting, the first anime season and the sales. Some are one detail off, so read closely.

questions.question: Hyūganatsu is the author of the story, and Touko Shino draws the illustrations of the published light novels.
The tale began as a web novel on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in 2017, then Shufunotomo issued a single book in 2012 and a Hero Bunko light novel line from August 29, 2014.
The tale began as a web novel on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in 2011, then Shufunotomo issued a single book in 2012 and a Hero Bunko light novel line from August 29, 2014.
Hyūganatsu is the author of the story, and Nekokurage draws the illustrations of the published light novels.
Square Enix publishes the first manga adaptation, drawn by Nekokurage, in Monthly Big Gangan; it started on May 25, 2017 and has reached 17 volumes.
The story takes place in an invented empire modeled on Ming-era China.
A second manga take, drawn by Minoji Kurata for Shogakukan's Monthly Sunday Gene-X, launched on August 19, 2017.
Square Enix publishes the first manga adaptation, drawn by Minoji Kurata, in Monthly Big Gangan; it started on May 25, 2017 and has reached 17 volumes.
Toho Animation Studio and OLM made the first anime season together, and its 24 episodes ran on Nippon TV from October 22, 2023 until March 24, 2024.
Counting the light novels and both manga series, the franchise had more than 17 million copies in circulation by August 2026.
